ATL.note: Over tax, under first apron. Many expiring contracts offer trade flexibility or 2027 cap space. Buyer/stand-pat.

BOS.note: Tatum returns healthy. Hard-capped at first apron, limiting trade flexibility. High payroll, likely stand-pat.

BKN.note: Cap space, multiple draft picks. Porter Jr. extension eligible. High trade flexibility, buyer.

CHA.note: Over cap, under first apron. Roster built via exceptions. Mix of young talent and veterans. Moderate trade flexibility.

CHI.note: Under cap, hard-capped at first apron. Movable contracts. Young core. High flexibility for trades, buyer/seller.

CLE.note: Most expensive roster, over second apron. Limited flexibility, likely stand-pat.

DET.note: Hard-capped at first apron. Young core locked up. Some movable contracts. Limited trade flexibility.

IND.note: Haliburton returns healthy. Hard-capped at first apron, over tax. Limited trade flexibility. Furphy recovering from ACL.

MIA.note: Over tax, under first apron. Core of Giannis/Bam. Wiggins' decreasing salary offers future flexibility. Limited trade flexibility.

MIL.note: Hard-capped at first apron. Lillard dead cap. Many expiring contracts offer significant 2027 flexibility. Potential sellers.

NYK.note: Over first apron. Core of Towns, Anunoby, Brunson, Bridges. Limited trade flexibility, likely stand-pat.

ORL.note: Over first apron. Strong young core. Limited trade flexibility. Relying on internal development.

PHI.note: Over tax, under first apron. Strong core (Embiid, Brown, Maxey, LeBron). Embiid's health is key. Some trade chips.

TOR.note: Over tax, under first apron. Core of Kawhi, Barnes. Relying on young player development. Limited trade flexibility.

WAS.note: #1 pick Dybantsa. New core with Young, Davis. Over tax, under first apron. High upside, developing new core.

DAL.note: Anthony Davis in Dallas. Under tax/aprons. Irving/Lively II returning from injury. Good trade flexibility.

DEN.note: Over second apron, high luxury tax. Limited flexibility. Strawther injured. Johnson expiring, potential trade chip.

GSW.note: Largest payroll, over first apron. Major injuries to Butler, Moody, Porzingis. Curry on slow ramp-up. Limited trade flexibility.

HOU.note: Under tax/aprons. VanVleet, Adams return healthy. Durant's age/durability a factor. Potential buyers, aiming for deep playoff run.

LAC.note: Under tax/aprons. Many injuries. Forfeited 5 first-round picks. Many tradeable veterans. Rebuilding, likely sellers.

LAL.note: Luka Doncic era. Under tax/aprons. Doncic is cornerstone. Moderate trade flexibility, buyers.

MEM.note: Significant cap space. Young core. Over roster limit. High trade flexibility, buyers.

MIN.note: Over first apron. DiVincenzo out most of season (Achilles). Lack frontcourt depth. Limited trade flexibility.

NOP.note: Under tax/aprons. Strong core. Zion's health/consistency key. Moderate trade flexibility, buyers.

OKC.note: Over first apron. Oweh (rookie) out for season (Achilles). Strong young core. Limited trade flexibility.

PHX.note: Over first apron, hard-capped. High luxury tax. Beal dead cap. Limited trade flexibility.

POR.note: Under tax/aprons. Morant acquired. Lillard returning from Achilles. Moderate trade flexibility, buyers.

SAC.note: Under tax/aprons. Lack backup PG/wing depth. Minor injuries. Moderate trade flexibility.

SAS.note: Deep young core, high cap flexibility. Wembanyama extended. Harris, Quaintance injured. Buyers/stand-pat.

UTA.note: Under tax/aprons. Nurkic, Filipowski injured. Strong young core. Good trade flexibility, buyers.
